    • JarType

      public JarType(char input)
      Create a jar with "p" or "q".
      Parameters:
      input - char Only "p" and "q" are valid.

    • JarType

      public JarType(char input, boolean isCaseSensitive)
      Create a jar with a character. For example, "a" refers to 1 and "A" refers to "27" (if it is case sensitive).
      Parameters:
      input - char The number of units in character you want to pre-fill the jar.
      isCaseSensitive - boolean True to set case sensitive mode. In this case, "A" will also refer to "1" as "a" does.
